name: H-box with label 0
summary: An H-box with label 0 is a standard H-box with one extra leg plugged by a phase-free Z-state.
description: An H-box with label $0$ has all entries $1$ except for a $0$ where all legs are $1$: as a function of the basis states it is the NAND. It can be written using only standard H-boxes: plugging a phase-free Z-state (i.e. summing) into one leg of a standard H-box gives $1 + (-1)^{x_1\cdots x_n}$, which is $2$ unless all $x_i$ are $1$, and $0$ otherwise. Hence the scalar factor 2.
parameter_notes: Shown for an H-box with n = 3 legs; holds for any n.

source.location: Section 2.5, the 0-labelled H-box of higher arity

notes: The H-boxes here are *unnormalised*: an H-box with label $a$ has all entries equal to $1$, except for the entry where all wires are $1$, which is $a$. The grey spiders of the ZH papers are normalised differently from the X-spiders of PyZX, so scalar factors may differ from those in the papers.
